text:
Alex M: Quick kickoff — OrbitData POC starts tomorrow. Need final alignment on success criteria + eval harness plan for 3 pilot flows: QA, long-form summarization, and invoice field extraction. Who owns golden set + scoring?
Maria S: I can own golden dataset curation. Proposal: 1k seed examples split across flows, + reserved 200 for blind acceptance. Suggest labels: exacts for invoice, span-level F1, and semantic similarity for QA/summaries.
Samir K: For QA/summaries let's use embedding cosine for semantic match + token-level overlap as fallback. Suggested thresholds: QA top-1 embedding >= 0.82, summary semantic sim >= 0.78 OR ROUGE-L >= 0.45. Invoice extraction: span F1 >= 0.9.
Lee T: Pricing question from procurement: if we need Dedicated for predictable latency, what's delta vs hosted for 500 qps peak? Short answer: ~x3 committed vs pay-as-you-go but predictability + reserved GPUs. I'll follow up with a cost appendix.
Jordan (OrbitData): Can we get criteria in a machine-readable format? Also need SOC2 + data residency note before we start ingesting PII for invoices.
sec-bot: Security checklist reminder — OrbitData flagged as regulated. Need completed security questionnaire, KMS integration plan, and confirmation about logs retention. I can attach the form.
Maria S: Machine-readable: yup. I'll export golden set metadata as CSV + JSON lines. Plan: fields = {case_id, flow, input, expected, label_type, tags}. We'll mark 200 as "acceptance_holdout".
Samir K: Eval harness plan (high level): nightly runs against full golden set, daily smoke on new model candidate, and continuous regression gate on commit. Gate rules: if mean QA sim drops > 0.03 or invoice F1 drops > 0.02 -> fail and alert.
Samir K: Example prompt template we'll use for harness (keeps tokens consistent):
```
INSTRUCTION: Answer the question using ONLY the provided context.
<CONTEXT>
{context}
</CONTEXT>
<QUESTION>
{question}
</QUESTION>
```
Maria S: We'll include metadata for each prompt: temperature, max_tokens, model_variant, input_length_bin. That helps isolate perf regressions.
Samir K: Scoring snippet (pseudo):
```json
{"metric":"embedding_cosine","reference_embedding":"emb_ref","threshold":0.82}
```
Maria S: Sampling: 5% manual review per run (stratified by flow and error type). We'll tag every failed example with error taxonomy: hallucination, truncation, format, wrong-value.
Lee T: Timeline: 2-week sprint. Week1 = golden set + harness infra + security form. Week2 = run baseline, accept/reject gates, price appendix.
Jordan (OrbitData): That timeline works. I'll get legal to start the security questionnaire. Also: can you add an accuracy SLA check as part of the acceptance gates? We need a written acceptance doc.
Alex M: Action items: @Maria S curate golden set + export JSON/CSV by EOD Thu. @Samir K wire up nightly eval job and implement gate thresholds by Fri. @Lee T produce cost appendix and note Dedicated delta. @Jordan coordinate security questionnaire with legal. sec-bot: attach questionnaire to thread.
Maria S: noted. I'll seed initial 300 examples today to unblock Samir.
Samir K: I'll mock the harness locally with the seed and push a smoke job to staging. CLI: `ri eval run --dataset s3://orbitdata/poc-golden --job smoke`.
Jordan (OrbitData): Great — thanks everyone. Keep me posted in this thread.
Alex M: Perfect. We'll check back end of week. :thumbsup:
